description: Search StudiePoint's database of 300+ funded scholarships for African postgraduate students. Filter by destination country, field of study, minimum GPA (4.0 scale), degree level, and tier. Returns scholarship name, country, amount, deadline, minimum GPA, essay type, visa accessibility, and application URL.

field.description: Field of study. Examples: 'engineering', 'medicine', 'business', 'law', 'sciences', 'arts', 'agriculture', 'public health', 'economics', 'computer science'.

min_gpa.description: Maximum minimum GPA required (4.0 scale). Only return scholarships the student can qualify for.

tier.description: 'full_ride' = fully funded (tuition + living + flights). 'full_tuition' = tuition only, student funds living. 'affordable_eu' = low/no-tuition EU universities across 17 countries.

name: search_scholarships
